_note: Memory Quest (lesson 5) match-the-pairs cards. Level 1 pairs are for everyone; level 2 pairs are added for ages 9-11. Draft for expert review in week 7.

items.meaning: My body: only with my OK
items.remember: Nobody touches Keza's body without her OK, and nobody touches private parts.
Family and friends can come close, and Keza can still say no.
People Keza doesn't know stay out in the green zone.
Secrets about touching are never okay. Keza always tells.
A surprise, like a birthday present, is happy and is told soon. A worrying secret is not a surprise.
Someone known only online is in the green zone. No photos, no school name, and show an adult.
